contract.mechanics_status: active class-local executors bind gameplay by phase_id and keep timing data non-balancing

soldier_rifle.note: Accepted project weapon sprite reused as the spectral rank silhouette; no new isolated source frame was created.

soldier_grenade.note: Accepted project weapon sprite reused for the seven seeded grenades; no new isolated source frame was created.

soldier_bayonet.note: Accepted project weapon sprite reused for the three ghost infantry ranks; no new isolated source frame was created.

weapons.title: Приказ: Сплошной Огонь
weapons.silhouette: spectral rifle rank behind a raised war banner
weapons.motion_path: three aimed volleys sweeping one straight arena-crossing lane
weapons.impact_language: three muzzle-flash waves that break on the first dense group, then a smoke recall

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same war banner, spectral rifle rank, volley lane and three muzzle-flash waves on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: each volley is an alpha step on the lane and the rank's aim rotation is the beat
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 certification capture: peak opaque coverage 0.0032 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a scene-only render at the game's on-screen scale, 1152x648 sweep of the whole 3.20 s cast every 1/30 s plus every committed frame); the scene authors no full-screen surface; the fastest authored alpha track is MuzzleFlashWave at 0.94 Hz (three volleys per cast) on a lane-sized element

weapons.title: Семь Секунд до Ада
weapons.silhouette: seven oversized grenades seeded around one aim point
weapons.motion_path: high lob, then a shared shrinking fuse countdown over the static seeded formation
weapons.impact_language: outside-in chain detonation closing on a central fire column and a short burning crater

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same lob arc, seven seeded grenades and shrinking fuse ring on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: the fuse ring's contraction is the countdown read and its alpha pulse stays a ring-sized element
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 certification capture: peak opaque coverage 0.0054 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a scene-only render at the game's on-screen scale, 1152x648 sweep of the whole 3.50 s cast every 1/30 s plus every committed frame); the presence block declares a flash backdrop but the shipped scene authors no full-screen surface, so no full-screen flash exists to declare; the fastest authored alpha track is the ring-sized FuseRing pulse at 1.14 Hz, under the 3 Hz threshold

weapons.title: Последняя Атака
weapons.silhouette: three offset ranks of ghost infantry holding levelled bayonets
weapons.motion_path: three time-offset phalanx charges down one aimed corridor, hero never displaced
weapons.impact_language: crossed-bayonet pin, then a short frontal guard and a rally salute

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the shipped screen_shake toggle off the authored AnimationPlayer timeline plays exactly the same three ghost-infantry ranks, charge corridor, frontal guard and crossed-bayonet pin on the same timing, because the scene authors no camera-shake device: each rank's charge down the corridor is a positional step and the pin is a contrast cross
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 certification capture: peak opaque coverage 0.0026 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a scene-only render at the game's on-screen scale, 1152x648 sweep of the whole 3.80 s cast every 1/30 s plus every committed frame); the scene authors no full-screen surface and no authored alpha track rises more than once per cast (0.26 Hz)

live_capture.note: Four-mode live frames per weapon and viewport, one native-size PNG per combination at the active beat plus release/recovery at 1152x648, rendered from the shipped scenes with the hero, crowd at the declared crowd cap, hazards and the real ultimate HUD widget. `crowded` draws the declared crowd cap with the weapon's victim-impact flipbook routed through present(); `reduced_motion` applies the shipped screen_shake toggle; `photosensitivity_safe` additionally has no full-screen surface to suppress because the scenes author none (verified by the gate). The four legacy resolution sheets above remain the FAN-1468 contact sheets.

certification.note: One native-size frame per weapon x mode x viewport at the active beat plus release and recovery at 1152x648, rendered from the shipped scenes at the game's on-screen scale with the hero, crowd, hazards and the real ultimate HUD widget; the capture manifest pins every file hash, the engine, the command and the measured coverage.
